preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(c, str) and len(c) == 1 for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each element in the result is a single-character string.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == len({c for c in input if input.count(c) > 1})
postconditions.description: The result contains exactly the unique characters that repeat in the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(c in input for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every character in the result must appear in the input string.
Every character in the result must repeat in the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == next(c for c in input if input.count(c) > 1 and c not in return_value[:i]), i in range(len(return_value)))
postconditions.description: The result preserves the order of first repetition of each character in the input string.
